ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(select type from sysobjects where name='ProdPlanowanaIloscITermin' and type='FN') drop function CDN.ProdPlanowanaIloscITermin

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ProdPlanowanaIloscITermin(@Zasob int,@Czynnosc int,@Termin int,@Proces int,@Zlecenie int,@Oddzial int) RETURNS varchar(30) as begin declare @Ilosc decimal(11,4) declare @TerminZwroc int
declare @planowane table (Ilosc decimal(11,4), Termin int, Czynnosc int)
if @Termin>0 insert into @planowane select Ilosc, Termin, Czynnosc--@Ilosc = sum(Ilosc) from CDN.ProdPlanowane(@Proces,@Zlecenie,@Oddzial) where Zasob=@Zasob and Czynnosc<>isnull(@Czynnosc,0) and Ilosc > 0 else begin insert into @planowane select Ilosc, Termin, Czynnosc from CDN.ProdPlanowane(@Proces,@Zlecenie,@Oddzial) where Zasob=@Zasob and Czynnosc<>isnull(@Czynnosc,0) and Ilosc > 0 and Termin<=-@Termin end select top 1 @termin = P.Termin from @planowane P order by P.Termin
select @Ilosc = SUM(P.Ilosc) from @planowane P
return cast(isnull(@ilosc,0) as varchar)+':'+cast(isnull(@termin,0) as varchar) end
GRANT EXEC ON CDN.ProdPlanowanaIloscITermin TO CDNRaport
